programme.desc: 主持王祖蓝、盖世宝及戚黛黛一如以往表演精采开场歌舞，并随即请出特别嘉宾吴日言献唱儿歌<魔法变变变，Yan及后又与主持合唱经典儿歌<小小姑娘。另外，吴日言还与现场小朋友玩游戏「动作马拉松」及「动手动脚动脑筋」，王祖蓝今次就把口技发挥在发问IQ题上，考考小朋友的音乐知识，戚黛黛则弹结他伴奏大家合唱儿歌<数字歌。

programme.title: 爱犬讯号 #12 粤日
programme.desc: 乌尔松在店中突然打喷嚏，起因是未祐的前女友优子带著她的超小茶杯贵妇狗皇冠，穿著高跟鞋、以一身香水味来到店铺。看著前女友对自己的爱犬错误连连，未祐怒火中烧，并以驯犬师身分教导她怎样与狗狗相处。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主 #11 粤日
programme.desc: 今天偶像公主空间将举行喵喵嘉年华。与此同时，小美频道收到一个寻猫请求，根据网友消息，那猫猫还在乐园学园出现过。美月与阳葵继而在校内寻猫，发现小学部的游真举止可疑，原来他在偷偷饲养一只误闯学校的猫咪。

programme.title: 72行小人类 #5 粤
programme.desc: 这集共有五位小朋友进行行业试做，第一组小朋友分别是朱绍熙、郑欣怡及吕芊烨试做动物育婴员，虽被小老虎的突然反应吓倒，仍感到开心，亦想加入动物育婴员行列。另外有两位小人类周欣桥及曾子轩都想做足球员，由香港足球先生丘建威教导下练习及进行终极测试，周欣桥更获得丘建威亲笔签名球衣，令二人更想成为足球员。此外，节目亦介绍了高级模型制作师，由卢家豪介绍这个行业的工作性质；而「物尽奇用」则请来观众猜猜究竟是何物。

programme.title: 72行小人类 #6 粤
programme.desc: 这集共有五位小朋友进行行业试做，第一组小朋友分别是张艺峰、许帅及何淑贤试做兽医，三人积极学习兽医的工作，亦决定努力读书成为兽医。另外有两位小人类是龙凤胎黄漪浵及黄浚永学做金饰师傅，由金饰制作师何清教导下学习金饰制作过程，黄浚永最后更获得戒指一枚。此外，节目亦介绍了飞行区主任，由叶伟雄介绍这个行业的工作性质，而「物尽奇用」则请观众猜猜究竟是何物。

programme.desc: 姑毛发现了一个嘈杂的重金属摇滚音乐盒,他认为这很棒,但却令啫堡的其他人都抓狂。必须做点甚么!比路和米娜骗了姑毛并用魔术让盒子「消失」。没有了他的「劲爆音乐」盒子,姑毛十分苦恼。比路和米娜意识到音乐对姑毛有多重要,并让盒子重新出现。姑毛在过程中意识到即使他们不喜欢他的音乐也没关系,他有很多音乐盒可以满

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #12
programme.desc: 由于国王的奇怪睡眠习惯,女王把他赶出了城堡。被黑影和不寻常的声音所笼罩,国王立即到比路的房子寻求庇护,但他们离睡个好觉还很远。经过一系列奇怪的睡前仪式,比路终于明白问题所在,并帮助国王克服对夜晚的恐惧。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #13
programme.desc: 姑毛在啫喱莓树林里睡著了。国王在附近尝试用一台异常强大的机器打开他的汽水瓶,这台机器最终撞倒了啫喱树!姑毛在废墟中惊恐地醒来!他说服自己是罪魁祸首!比路和米娜收集线索,让国王为自己的行为负责,并让姑毛认清事实。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #50
programme.desc: 当其他人都得到赞扬和掌声时,要站著面对并不总是那么容易。比路尝试在他朋友的表演中抢尽风头,让他们非常沮丧,比路需要分享他的一些才能来解决问题。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #51
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛发现城堡里的所有玩具都放在一个盒子里,他们面对著一项几乎不可能完成的任务。虽然诱惑很大,但他们接到严格的命令,不能碰盒子,因为他们肯定会弄得一团糟。他们能服从命令,让城堡一尘不染吗?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #52
programme.desc: 还有比在音乐诞生的星球更适合跳舞的地方吗?啫堡上的每个人都会向您展示一段舞蹈,这样我们就可以随著啫堡的节奏一起跳舞。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #1
programme.desc: 比露使用超级生长配方,让植物(和渡渡鸟)抓狂并失控!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #2
programme.desc: 米娜想成为啫堡上的万人迷!她尝试在啫堡举办有史以来最好的派对!当她的四阶段乐趣计划未能为人们实现「最大乐趣」,她学会冷静下来,并听取朋友们的意见,了解如何让美好时光发生。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #3
programme.desc: 米娜不情愿地接受一项帮助迷路渡渡鸟的任务。莉塔自称「很了解」渡渡鸟,却让事情变得更糟。经过长时间的寻找,多得米娜的失败实验,渡渡鸟的父母被诱到牠们丢失的宝贝身边。即使渡渡鸟回到自己的家,米娜却交到一位心爱的小伙伴。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #4
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛承诺在莉塔去森林和渡渡鸟玩耍时照看她最喜欢的洋娃娃公主,但他们去玩啫喱波时却忘记了约定。无人看管的公主被想要向皇家访客展示他王国的国王抓住。男孩们必须围攻城堡,才能在莉塔回来前找到公主。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #5
programme.desc: 比路和姑毛化身成超级英雄啫堡侠和拍档侠,创造了奇幻的冒险,让他们碰上同样想扮演超级英雄的米娜和安高。结果导致一场关于超级英雄游戏规则的争论。当四位超级英雄崇拜者被召集到一场真正的冒险时,一切变成空谈:拯救被困在啫堡谷悬崖峭壁上的莉塔。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #6
programme.desc: 姑毛认为比路是他最好的朋友。不过,比路也是这样想吗?姑毛开始考验他们的友谊,但不断的考验却适得其反,令双方都不开心,他们去和「其他朋友」一起玩,但他们发现没有人比你的死党更有趣,也更了解你的特性。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #7
programme.desc: 国王玩他最喜欢的谢维斯玩具,玩得正开心时,莉塔要求想玩。国王认为自己是一个很好的分享者,就让给她。莉塔利用了国王的好心,很快就把他所有的玩具都骗走了!尽管莉塔一开始感到得意洋洋,但她的快乐却短暂。莉塔必须发现玩具最好的地方;就是当你与他人分享时,你会获得更多乐趣。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #8
programme.desc: 莉塔终于离渡渡鸟足够接近来抚摸它—但只是因为牠弄伤了脚。她把这只小动物带回家,用爱喂养牠,还给牠吃太多的食物。现在超重的渡渡鸟非常需要运动。莉塔明白到所谓的关心,是要对他人有好处,而不是对自己有益。如此一来,现在有了一个新的好朋友。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #9
programme.desc: 在看似平常的一天,姑毛出去慢跑时发现今天的啫堡略有不同。一切都停止不动!音乐停了。渡渡鸟停留在空中。连他的朋友们都僵硬得像雕像!这取决于姑毛和他有用的耳机来找出发生了甚么事,并让啫堡再次动起来。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #10
programme.desc: 在啫堡上探索春天的音乐本质时,姑毛意识到他害怕唱歌花。为了寻找治疗方法,米娜进行了一系列测试,以帮助姑毛处理他对唱歌植物的过度反应。最后姑毛意识到,当你了解自己的恐惧,就没甚么可怕的了。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #11
programme.desc: 姑毛发现了一个嘈杂的重金属摇滚音乐盒,他认为这很棒,但却令啫堡的其他人都抓狂。必须做点甚么!比路和米娜骗了姑毛并用魔术让盒子「消失」。没有了他的「劲爆音乐」盒子,姑毛十分苦恼。比路和米娜意识到音乐对姑毛有多重要,并让盒子重新出现。姑毛在过程中意识到即使他们不喜欢他的音乐也没关系,他有很多音乐盒可以满

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #12
programme.desc: 由于国王的奇怪睡眠习惯,女王把他赶出了城堡。被黑影和不寻常的声音所笼罩,国王立即到比路的房子寻求庇护,但他们离睡个好觉还很远。经过一系列奇怪的睡前仪式,比路终于明白问题所在,并帮助国王克服对夜晚的恐惧。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #13
programme.desc: 姑毛在啫喱莓树林里睡著了。国王在附近尝试用一台异常强大的机器打开他的汽水瓶,这台机器最终撞倒了啫喱树!姑毛在废墟中惊恐地醒来!他说服自己是罪魁祸首!比路和米娜收集线索,让国王为自己的行为负责,并让姑毛认清事实。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #14
programme.desc: 米娜发明了一个巨型机器人来给啫堡换灯泡。比路认为机械人应该用来保护啫堡免受入侵者的侵扰!在米娜不知情的情况下,他修改了「啫堡机械人」的程式,导致它发生故障,并大肆破坏啫喱星。比路明白了「别碰我的东西!」这句话背后的含义。

programme.desc: 阿彩、阿好、阿钻、阿三皆为女佣，各有不幸遭遇。阿彩认识了有钱少爷杜仑，一心以为可以结婚享福，可是当阿彩怀有杜仑骨肉，并借钱予他后，才发现杜仑已有妻子。阿好尽心尽力服侍陆家三十多年，更借钱给主人陆云璋做生意，结果却被嫌弃年老而遭解雇。阿钻为姪儿何通觅得妻子，但因迷信而没有将病重的何通送院医治，令何通病死。阿三努力工作储钱入斋堂，却误信生神仙之言，差点被骗去毕生积蓄，幸得阿英识破，更鼓励各人勇敢生活。

programme.desc: 天虹国主帅盖天鸿向海棠国下战书，海棠公主遂往芙蓉国欲游说联盟抵抗，却被鸿截获，鸿一念之仁放走她。海棠国得援兵相助，鸿兵败如山倒被擒。海棠公主不忍恩将仇报，求国王放过鸿。其后鸿更凭玉珮认回亲妹芙蓉公主。

programme.title: 改造小姐
programme.desc: 富家子何家强与田均、杜莉莉遇上乡村姑娘杨小燕，强认为燕经特训后，必成摩登女性，遂与均、莉打赌，并以半年时间为限。燕因不惯名媛淑女的礼仪而闹出笑话。强对燕日久生情，而燕学有所成惜合约期满，燕留信离去……

programme.title: 血绣鞋
programme.desc: 陈汉希与表妹李紫英互生情愫，惜英无奈下嫁庞树中。英撞破中的奸情被杀，中把英的绣花鞋藏于希的房内嫁祸希，更派人放火杀希。当晚英原来未死，遇中表弟琪，琪色心顿起，英被逼跳河。希假扮僵尸吓中，中终自揭真相。

programme.title: 魔爪神鞭
programme.desc: 李剑鸿求姻缘，竟娶得化身为青蛙的荷花仙子为妻。蝙蝠精掳去花，鸿与兄长前往营救，伏魔仙姬试出鸿之真诚，以神鞭助他消灭蝠，可惜花已遭毒手。鸿不惜牺牲性命救回花，仙翁被二人情深所感动，赐予灵芝草，让鸿复活。

programme.title: 彩凤引金龙
programme.desc: 富家子赵金龙与赛彩凤情投意合，龙为了试探凤，在表哥马明德帮助下，对凤装穷试其真情。凤遭势利父亲逼婚，好友黎英请明装作凤的情人，明因英答允假扮龙之女友，故同意帮忙。连串谎言虽被拆穿，但龙与彩终亦成眷属。

programme.title: 节妇审贪官
programme.desc: 麦中昌投军后，其兄麦伯和假传昌死讯夺家产。和妻甘氏指使张器劫和，器却误杀和，于是甘氏嫁祸给昌妻李玉娥。甘氏与知府胡恩有染，娥被判处斩。昌立功当官归来欲重审案件，恩拒并即行刑，幸器良心发现，娥沉冤得雪。

programme.title: 得咗
programme.desc: 马祥与李核、天娜兄妹得万事通所聘，祥被派往照顾病重的富翁周公。周公的侄儿大伟及其妹等人觊觎周公家财，幸祥尽心照顾，周公病情好转，愤而赶伟等人离去。伟诱核吸毒，更逼娜色诱周公继而勒索，祥得悉后报警救人。

programme.title: 亲上加亲
programme.desc: 李家驹对与表嫂叶曼丝外貌相似的施曼珠一见倾心。丝因丈夫汪继昌嗜赌，愤而离家，众人误将珠带回家。驹在昌家遇上珠，却误认是丝。珠以丝身份试探驹，却被昌误会，时丝母带丝回家，认出珠是丝的孪生妹妹，误会尽消。

programme.title: 花好月圆
programme.desc: 陈佩娥为家境所逼而嫁富商刘绍基为妾，婚后受基妻逼害，苦不堪言。娥本与郑中坚相恋，坚为挣钱出外谋生，并允诺回来娶娥。数年后，坚欲与娥重新开始，基得悉后与坚争执，混乱间娥被车撞倒。基知错，惜娥已返魂乏术。

programme.title: 情侠情仇
programme.desc: 秦明命女儿少华押运镖银，华巧遇马云龙，暗生情愫。盖雄彪与女儿马素贞为投靠黑风堡，偷走华的镖银，华闯黑风堡却被擒。明领人攻打黑风堡，龙被彪所骗，向明出手。明向龙言明真相，龙终杀彪为父报仇，贞为救龙而死。

programme.title: 美人恩
programme.desc: 辛凤英一家在梁百芬的公司工作，二人偶遇，英及家人不知芬是其老板，向芬诉苦。英误以为芬生活捉襟见肘，为他安排工作，芬决定「微服出巡」。芬得悉公司种种问题，即提出改革，并向英及其家人表明身分后，向英求婚。

programme.title: 天涯芳草
programme.desc: 兵荒马乱，柳天涯与梁芳草约定战后共谐连理。程雨庭长子早逝，庭逼草入门为媳。战事结束，涯得知草被逼冥婚一事，于是伺机混入程家。庭为草立贞节牌匾，草与涯在乡民们前控诉庭，庭眼见群情汹涌，终醒悟，成全二人。

programme.title: 铁马神龙
programme.desc: 胡人入侵马家村，马明章之父被卖国土豪彭冬发手下打死，章被逐出村。章妻林淑英为生计当发女小碧的乳娘，与章分离。多年后，章派两名儿子往马家村打探，两子被擒。英与碧帮忙救人，碧最终更化解了彭、马两家的仇怨。

programme.title: 金鸥
programme.desc: 黑帮厉以彪的珠宝疑遭顾大强抢去，彪找金震宇合作把珠宝夺回。期间，宇发现神秘女子金鸥也在追寻珠宝，两人协议合作。后宇知悉彪设局要他与强互相残杀，故他与鸥、强对付彪，而珠宝原属鸥亡兄拥有，宇无奈让鸥拿回。

programme.title: 蝴蝶公墓普
programme.desc: 舞蹈家尚小蝶,为五年前离开的恋人编排了一支蝶舞,大获成功,受国外文化基金邀请去布达佩斯选角编舞小蝶在所有舞者中最看好自卑的白露,白露告诉小蝶,想要借助蝴蝶公墓找到失踪的姐姐小蝶还发现,基金继承人庄秋水就是自己五年前的恋人但随着舞者宋优中毒,田巧坠楼,白露失踪,小蝶自己也受到威胁一切谜团都指向了蝴蝶公墓

programme.title: 神枪手与咖喱鸡粤普
programme.desc: 岑健昌与江理基是香港皇家警察中的两名干探,两人因为身手了得,手法火爆,屡破奇案身手所以在警界,有棘手双雄之称故事的发生是因为有一帮会的龙头大哥被人暗杀,警方估计将会有可能引起连串的江湖大火拼,所以派出在警界有枪王之称的枪王英主持调查该案,而岑健昌与江理基则负责协助枪王英调查起初两人不服枪王英的办事方法,处处发生冲突,直至枪王英向两人表现出其精湛的枪法及其对枪械的丰富知识,两人才开始对枪王

programme.title: 花花型警粤普

programme.title: 白蛇传
programme.desc: 妖精白素贞跟妹妹青青在凡间巧遇前世救命恩人书生许仙,后更以身相许给许仙后和尚法海揭穿其身份并把这对苦命鸳鸯拆散

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 马腾是雍正的密令组织「血滴子特务团」的其中一位杀手当马腾质疑其特务行动是否有违道义时,却旋即变成被同伴追捕的逃犯

programme.title: 山歌恋
programme.desc: 牧羊女古秀秀喜唱山歌,父亲嗜赌如命;青年刘大龙与秀对唱山歌,情愫互生曾老虎以追债要胁古老头许婚;刘欲酬钱替秀父还债怎知帆船归来而刘却失踪!秀无奈答允出嫁

programme.title: 皇家大贼
programme.desc: 干探周福祥的好友阿金因误杀途人而辞职,沦为职业杀手金所执行的多宗凶杀案中,恰巧由周负责,好友二人面临生死决斗

programme.title: 喷火美人鱼
programme.desc: 三对年青男女出海渡假,忽然听到新闻报导:一个穿红色比坚尼泳衣的女郎一连杀了十三人,并正驾驶著快艇逃亡正在此时,一个美的女郎破浪而来,身穿红色比坚尼女郎要求跟他们同上岛避风当晚,女郎的挑逗令众男女之间产生前所未有的冲突 电影未到最后一分钟,不知结局

programme.title: 夺魂铃
programme.desc: 故事描述,少年卫虎家遭左景龙、应天与杨刚所洗劫,父母幼弟被杀,姊卫芸被左劫走,顿时家破人亡虎愤恨万状,放火烧毁家园,决心远走天涯,找寻仇人报复;虎流浪各地,遇隐名大侠士,投拜为师,数年即习艺有成,遂往找仇人;虎抵鸡儿镇,遇弱女香香遭逼为娼,逐出手相助,击退歹徒

programme.title: 城市之光
programme.desc: 导演张坚庭在本片体现香港八十年代的大城小景;陈友与妻子惠英红从大陆来港投靠父亲,却发现他并非如信中所言生活富足东方之珠的美梦换来悲喜交集

programme.title: 教头
programme.desc: 河东府教头王阳受地方土绅孟二达陷害,成杀人疑犯,惟匿藏孟家任教头后王收好武青年周平为徒,却惹孟不满;原来周、孟两大族为死敌,孟觉聘王当教头,实乃养虎为患,遂唆使大盗「一条鞭」施以偷袭,幸王逃过大难,只是受了伤孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所为,且对王很有好感,遂暗中援手

programme.title: 椰林春恋
programme.desc: 富少平建人拒绝继承父业,与女友苏咏兰合办旅行社在接待来自香港的旅行团时,一名情窦初开的女学生爱上建人,引发一连串爱情误会咏兰醋意大发愤然离去,女学生因惊闻建人婚讯而恍惚驾车撞山重伤经过一番波折,众人终于解开误会,建人与咏兰也在南洋椰林下迎来幸福结局

programme.title: 广东靓仔玉
programme.desc: 清廷高手骆一虎杀害反清义士陈贵,陈妻偕女小薇逃往广龙镇镇上两家武馆势成水火,何教头之侄家玉生性调皮,因营救小薇识破了老师为反清首领的身份随著至亲与恩师相继丧命于骆一虎之手,原本好胜顽皮的家玉愤而承担起复仇重任,与清廷势力展开生死决战

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神
programme.desc: 军阀割据时代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的传统骗术层出不穷,「蛇神」、「李三脚」、「三只手」等一群妖言惑众的骗徒令人云亦云的愚民上钓,反映旧时代一切牛鬼蛇神众生相

programme.title: 目无王法
programme.desc: 何中衡、秦英豪及罗正三个初出茅庐的捕快,秉除暴安良,维护法纪之宗旨,尽力扑灭罪行,县中赌馆妓院,均遭扫荡三人因坚拒与贪赃枉法的县官与捕头同流合污,而惨被陷害

programme.title: 大罗剑侠
programme.desc: 女侠明珠的师父遭黑虎帮歹徒偷袭重伤,临终嘱往找故友之女青青,探问失踪财宝歹徒偷听得遗言,先去劫走青青,途遇「大罗剑侠」周应龙,怒打不平……

programme.title: 欲燄狂流
programme.desc: 故事描述饰花花公子的乔庄与好友杨帆,同时爱上胡燕妮,但杨成人之美但乔因生殖力弱,故当胡怀孕时,就怀疑妻与杨有染…

programme.title: 欲燄狂流

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 小宝阴差阳错地闯入宫廷,意外成为康熙皇帝的好友此时,他又受到天地会的命令,必须窃取极为重要的四十二章经,而康熙皇帝本人也在追查其下落聪明的小宝在两方敌对势力之间周旋,最终凭借聪明才智成功脱险

programme.title: 三十年细说从头
programme.desc: 大导演李翰祥改编自己大受欢迎的专栏,尽现电影圈光怪陆离的趣事及传闻,由爱将刘永和戴良纯扮演不同角色,保证令你捧腹大笑

programme.title: 十四女英豪
programme.desc: 赤胆忠心的杨家将,世世代代为国而战,子子孙孙为民而死,直战到最后一员虎将杨宗保,不幸在金山之役中了埋伏,全营将士壮烈牺牲杨宗保身负箭伤,被困金山,以身殉国杨家满门为保卫宋朝江山及替杨宗保报仇,在老祖母佘老太君的发起下,组成了一支杨家军,誓与番邦周旋到底!

programme.title: 春暖花开
programme.desc: 故事描述,陈太太有女洁玉及美玉,洁玉已工作,美玉仍求学适逢陈家有空房出租,少奇来租,一谈即合;洁玉三个姊姊,皆与租客结婚,所以洁玉表姊赵静兰之母决仿效陈家租房选婿未几,一医科学生欣农来租房,赵母见他是理想快婿,忙出租原来少奇与欣农是同学,少奇老成寡言,被洁玉、美玉视为怪人,欣农则只顾谈恋爱…

programme.title: 荒江女侠
programme.desc: 铁臂金刚方甯、方静押送赈银救济黄河灾民,途中受到盗寇的突袭,全家老少遭杀害,惟稚女方瑛琪为玄真道长救出,抱入深山抚养瑛琪长成后,尽得玄真道长武功真传其时金兵图大举进犯中原,玄真道长授瑛琪一剑一信,著其下山投效义军首领夏子龙

programme.title: 杨乃武与小白菜
programme.desc: 剧情讲述,知县之子刘子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷药将其奸污刘子和事后恐东窗事发,用砒霜毒死葛小大葛死后,镇内流言四起,知县为救爱儿,设计嫁祸小白菜婚前恋人杨乃武乃武被苦打成招,其姊杨淑英不忍见弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……

programme.title: 飞燕金刀
programme.desc: 总镖头李志山的妻子私通对头人龙震天,并设计先偷飞龙刀,再杀害李志山及女儿小燕,幸好最后李氏父女成功逃脱小燕长大后,更成为武功高强的女剑客,誓要为死去的母亲报仇直至一个偶然的机会,小燕遇到仍然在生的母亲,才骇然发现真相,原来自己一直被父亲的谎言所蒙骗

programme.title: 射雕英雄传续集
programme.desc: 欧阳锋得悉郭靖以九阴真经的功夫于选婿比武中获胜,并娶得黄蓉为妻,于是把黄蓉挟走,要胁郭靖要默写九阴真经才会释放黄蓉最终郭靖会否为救出黄蓉而就范?

programme.title: 无名英雄
programme.desc: 街头浪荡客孟刚与铁虎虽玩世不恭,却心怀侠义一次偶然,孟刚结识革命军首领万泰,在其感召下,两兄弟决心投身革命在孟刚女友的协助下,他们成功潜入军阀阵营,智取军火送往前线然而,在与军阀的激战中,三人相继壮烈牺牲,成为湮没于历史中的「无名英雄」

programme.title: 玫瑰我爱你
programme.desc: 十八岁的玫瑰在澳门结识了富家子家聪太平洋战争爆发,两人被迫分手七年后,玫瑰得知家聪结婚,伤心痛哭玫瑰婚后,丈夫去世,开了一间花店,一天,小女孩来买花,才知小女孩是自己女儿,更与家聪重遇文艺导演秦剑的爱情悲喜剧,保持作深情,感人之水准

programme.title: 五毒天罗
programme.desc: 《五毒天罗》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方五毒教的蛇坛主,要找出天罗所在,独霸武林,误放消息,谓天罗已重现武林,江湖一片风声鹤唳…

programme.title: 凤还巢

programme.desc: 斑马为何有斑纹?企鹅如何在水底看东西?为何树蛙的眼睛是红色的?在可见的探索中,发掘一些动物如何进化以达到极佳的视力,而另一些却进化至几乎隐形

programme.desc: 有人称牠们为「活化石」,但这只是对幸存者的另一个称呼从鲨鱼到鲎,这些动物的早期适应都十分成功,让牠们数百万年来相对地保持不变

programme.title: 动物玩学志 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的动物大部分时间都在玩耍从喜欢追逐的猫,到可以解决谜题的黑猩猩新研究表明游戏几乎是动物学习的全部核心,它不仅是乐趣和游戏

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #1
programme.desc: 在海陆相连的公园中,自然元素相互结合,创造出美妙的多样性可乐色的水使森林变得翠绿和茂密火与风促进多样性的增长,岩石形成了众多面貌的海岸线生命在这里茁壮成长 - 从壮丽到奇异,这是花园大道国家公园

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格尔国家公园北部,赖以维生的元素就是水在炎热和干旱的土地上,一条丝带在荒野中切割出可靠的路线它是不论大小所有生物的生命线

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #3
programme.desc: 伟大的奥兰治河有著56米高壮观的奥赫拉比斯瀑布奥赫拉比斯源于「oukurubes」这个词,在南玛改的土著语言中意思是「雷霆之地」,这片土地是一个苛刻和阳光充沛世界的中心,充满绚丽色彩和雷鸣般的咆哮

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #4
programme.desc: 地球上从最小到最大的任何生物都离不开食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些动物极力求生,而另一些则茁壮成长所有动物都为寻找生存所需展开旅程,牠们必须决定在何时何地移动来获取成功这就是赞比西河下游的神奇世界

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #5
programme.desc: 在南非祖鲁兰中心地带,有著非洲大陆最古老的野生动物保护区 - 赫卢赫卢韦 - 乌姆福洛济禁猎区南方白犀牛在动荡时期于此找到了保护在19世纪末几乎因为被捕猎而完全灭绝,公园的建立为犀牛提供了一条生路 - 让牠们从绝种中恢复过来

programme.title: 海滩「龟」来记
programme.desc: 当成千上万的海龟日以继夜登上哥斯达黎加的海滩生下数以百万计的蛋,当地人称之为「到达」本节目满是新发现,加拿大自然学家及摄影师胡戈基奇跟随一队国际科学家团队进行创新性的科学考察,以解开这个稀有现象的谜底

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 在秘鲁的山脉,一小群眼镜熊为生存而战孤儿阿马逊娜必须学会独立老去的东哥没时间找到配偶,很难才能俘虏理想对象曹莉达

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜达卢普岛附近,顶尖鲨鱼生态学家莫利斯奥许尤士先使用遥视他将摄影机安装在大白鲨的鳍上,拍摄到一个独特的视野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩猎,并且最终袭击猎物

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #2 英普
programme.desc: 前往巴哈马的偏远地区,解开鲨鱼的秘密牠们交友吗?牠们在哪里生育?有品种比其他大胆吗?答案可能有助保护这些至高无上掠食者的后代

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #3 英普
programme.desc: 海中最快的鱼,尖吻鲭鲨通常是恒温的,这使牠具有敏捷思维以及惊人速度的优势跟随这种纽西兰海岸附近相对未被研究的品种

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #4 英普
programme.desc: 鲨鱼经常被描绘成容易攻击人类的无脑进食机器,但是它们的行为比之前所认为的更加复杂和聪明找出这些优雅的顶级捕食者如何互动,选择朋友,甚至训导其他同类

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 英普
programme.desc: 跟随阿纳斯塔西亚的足迹,牠的象群因为保护两只珍贵的小象而兵分两路,而猎豹库莱塔则为牠剩下的幼崽夺回领地尘土散去,雨水开始滋润干涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯寻找新伴侣的旅程

programme.title: 大猫九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描绘狮子生命的九个阶段,从无助的小狮子到自信的成年狮,再到年老的流亡者看看竞争、饥饿和骄傲的动态如何塑造它在塞伦盖提的生活,并见证使这种社交猫独特的忠诚和合作精神

programme.title: 大猫九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与一只小小的幼狮一起在森林中穿行,观看年轻的成年狮如何宣示自己的领土,并见证年老猎人的不可避免的流亡发现本能和潜行如何帮助老虎在它孤独的世界中生存,在这里每一个决定都充满风险

programme.title: 大猫九命 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在严酷的环境和不断的挑战中奋战,看看豹子如何不断智胜敌人以获取食物并保护幼崽穿越冰冷的山峰和干燥的河床,在这里任何的遭遇都可能改变这只猫的命运,无论是好是坏

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与丹一同踏上旅程,穿越严酷无情的蒙古荒野,只为寻找那只史上有纪录以来体型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充满敌意、危机四伏的地形与环境中奋力前行,并在未知与不确定中披荆斩棘,同时揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面临的艰难挑战与严峻现实

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟随丹与他的团队,一同在「老兄」的领地中嗅探、追踪,他们怀疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能远比先前想像的更加关键、更具影响力当丹意外发现一群雪豹聚集的反常现象时,对雪豹行为的既有研究与认知也因此受到冲击与挑战

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟随一只老迈的豹子三天,她正努力觅食,同时试图避开恶魔般的邻居:一个清道夫狮子群

programme.desc: 斑马为何有斑纹?企鹅如何在水底看东西?为何树蛙的眼睛是红色的?在可见的探索中,发掘一些动物如何进化以达到极佳的视力,而另一些却进化至几乎隐形

programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的来临,豹妈妈费芙和狮妈妈莎芭正在教导她们的幼宝宝如何在危机四伏的野外求存,并让他们远离成年雄性的威胁看看狮王莫雷洛如何战斗,猎豹森娜蒂亚则试图在战场上证明自己的地位

programme.title: 进化的奥秘 #6
programme.desc: 有人称牠们为「活化石」,但这只是对幸存者的另一个称呼从鲨鱼到鲎,这些动物的早期适应都十分成功,让牠们数百万年来相对地保持不变

programme.title: 动物玩学志 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的动物大部分时间都在玩耍从喜欢追逐的猫,到可以解决谜题的黑猩猩新研究表明游戏几乎是动物学习的全部核心,它不仅是乐趣和游戏

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #1
programme.desc: 在海陆相连的公园中,自然元素相互结合,创造出美妙的多样性可乐色的水使森林变得翠绿和茂密火与风促进多样性的增长,岩石形成了众多面貌的海岸线生命在这里茁壮成长 - 从壮丽到奇异,这是花园大道国家公园

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格尔国家公园北部,赖以维生的元素就是水在炎热和干旱的土地上,一条丝带在荒野中切割出可靠的路线它是不论大小所有生物的生命线

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #3
programme.desc: 伟大的奥兰治河有著56米高壮观的奥赫拉比斯瀑布奥赫拉比斯源于「oukurubes」这个词,在南玛改的土著语言中意思是「雷霆之地」,这片土地是一个苛刻和阳光充沛世界的中心,充满绚丽色彩和雷鸣般的咆哮

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #4
programme.desc: 地球上从最小到最大的任何生物都离不开食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些动物极力求生,而另一些则茁壮成长所有动物都为寻找生存所需展开旅程,牠们必须决定在何时何地移动来获取成功这就是赞比西河下游的神奇世界

programme.title: 非洲园游志 #5
programme.desc: 在南非祖鲁兰中心地带,有著非洲大陆最古老的野生动物保护区 - 赫卢赫卢韦 - 乌姆福洛济禁猎区南方白犀牛在动荡时期于此找到了保护在19世纪末几乎因为被捕猎而完全灭绝,公园的建立为犀牛提供了一条生路 - 让牠们从绝种中恢复过来

programme.title: 海滩「龟」来记
programme.desc: 当成千上万的海龟日以继夜登上哥斯达黎加的海滩生下数以百万计的蛋,当地人称之为「到达」本节目满是新发现,加拿大自然学家及摄影师胡戈基奇跟随一队国际科学家团队进行创新性的科学考察,以解开这个稀有现象的谜底

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 在秘鲁的山脉,一小群眼镜熊为生存而战孤儿阿马逊娜必须学会独立老去的东哥没时间找到配偶,很难才能俘虏理想对象曹莉达

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜达卢普岛附近,顶尖鲨鱼生态学家莫利斯奥许尤士先使用遥视他将摄影机安装在大白鲨的鳍上,拍摄到一个独特的视野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩猎,并且最终袭击猎物

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #2 英普
programme.desc: 前往巴哈马的偏远地区,解开鲨鱼的秘密牠们交友吗?牠们在哪里生育?有品种比其他大胆吗?答案可能有助保护这些至高无上掠食者的后代

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #3 英普
programme.desc: 海中最快的鱼,尖吻鲭鲨通常是恒温的,这使牠具有敏捷思维以及惊人速度的优势跟随这种纽西兰海岸附近相对未被研究的品种

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #4 英普
programme.desc: 鲨鱼经常被描绘成容易攻击人类的无脑进食机器,但是它们的行为比之前所认为的更加复杂和聪明找出这些优雅的顶级捕食者如何互动,选择朋友,甚至训导其他同类

programme.title: 逐雨之途 #3 英普
programme.desc: 跟随阿纳斯塔西亚的足迹,牠的象群因为保护两只珍贵的小象而兵分两路,而猎豹库莱塔则为牠剩下的幼崽夺回领地尘土散去,雨水开始滋润干涸的大地,加入野狗菲尼克斯寻找新伴侣的旅程

programme.title: 大猫九命 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​描绘狮子生命的九个阶段,从无助的小狮子到自信的成年狮,再到年老的流亡者看看竞争、饥饿和骄傲的动态如何塑造它在塞伦盖提的生活,并见证使这种社交猫独特的忠诚和合作精神

programme.title: 大猫九命 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与一只小小的幼狮一起在森林中穿行,观看年轻的成年狮如何宣示自己的领土,并见证年老猎人的不可避免的流亡发现本能和潜行如何帮助老虎在它孤独的世界中生存,在这里每一个决定都充满风险

programme.title: 大猫九命 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在严酷的环境和不断的挑战中奋战,看看豹子如何不断智胜敌人以获取食物并保护幼崽穿越冰冷的山峰和干燥的河床,在这里任何的遭遇都可能改变这只猫的命运,无论是好是坏

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与丹一同踏上旅程,穿越严酷无情的蒙古荒野,只为寻找那只史上有纪录以来体型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充满敌意、危机四伏的地形与环境中奋力前行,并在未知与不确定中披荆斩棘,同时揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面临的艰难挑战与严峻现实

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟随丹与他的团队,一同在「老兄」的领地中嗅探、追踪,他们怀疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能远比先前想像的更加关键、更具影响力当丹意外发现一群雪豹聚集的反常现象时,对雪豹行为的既有研究与认知也因此受到冲击与挑战

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟随一只老迈的豹子三天,她正努力觅食,同时试图避开恶魔般的邻居:一个清道夫狮子群

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在严酷的环境和不断的挑战中奋战,看看豹子如何不断智胜敌人以获取食物并保护幼崽穿越冰冷的山峰和干燥的河床,在这里任何的遭遇都可能改变这只猫的命运,无论是好是坏

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与丹一同踏上旅程,穿越严酷无情的蒙古荒野,只为寻找那只史上有纪录以来体型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充满敌意、危机四伏的地形与环境中奋力前行,并在未知与不确定中披荆斩棘,同时揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面临的艰难挑战与严峻现实

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟随丹与他的团队,一同在「老兄」的领地中嗅探、追踪,他们怀疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能远比先前想像的更加关键、更具影响力当丹意外发现一群雪豹聚集的反常现象时,对雪豹行为的既有研究与认知也因此受到冲击与挑战

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟随一只老迈的豹子三天,她正努力觅食,同时试图避开恶魔般的邻居:一个清道夫狮子群

programme.title: 碧昂丝:乡村音乐女王
programme.desc: 关注碧昂丝诺尔斯卡特的人生和事业,从她早年担任组合「天命真女」主唱到现在的单飞生涯探讨这位超级巨星多年来的音乐风格和灵感是如何演变的

programme.title: 珍娜·杰克森:诱惑的艺术
programme.desc: 珍妮积逊以其强烈的独立性、有吸力的气质和迷人的嗓音而闻名,她在MTV的成长成为她的催化剂;接受她的身份,并到达明星的巅峰

programme.title: 山缪杰克森:给我听好

programme.title: 街头美食通 #1

programme.title: 街头美食通 #2

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #4

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #5

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 2 #7
programme.desc: 詹姆斯和奥利弗与斯坦尼斯拉夫·伊恩奈夫斯基一同踏上前往科莫湖的公路之旅途经法国葡萄园与瑞士阿尔卑斯山,他们学习钟表制造、征服险峻的富尔卡隘口,最终在科莫湖上以轻松的游船之旅结束行程

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #2

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out However, Pu Yi was not alone Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: Continuing his quest for belief, host Tevya get's a fresh look at the history and traditions of the Hasidic Jews (a little different to the Judaism he was used to) Rabbi Kaplan and some new friends offer insight into the most important passage in a Jewish boy's life, the Bar Mitzvah, celebrate Purim and have dinner with the Rabbi's family Can Rabbi Kaplan reveal the answer to one of the burning questions - why can't Jews eat bacon?

programme.title: Kabul, Just Before Darkness
programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

programme.title: Silent Forests

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own The crime shocked the whole country What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? programme.desc: 圣经最后的一卷启示录,常被信徒,甚至普世人类所注重。可惜的是,被误解和误用的情况却很普遍。解释启示录最大的问题,便是读者们对于此书卷的体裁所知甚少,以致不明白诠释启示录的方法。本节目倾重于对启示录体裁的阐释,让观众明白如何将方法论,应用在各有关的经文上。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神秘(国语)
programme.desc: 从世界各地搜集到数以百计奇异事物内容,都是无法以一般人接受的观点加以解释,除非这个世界在科学理论上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音电影: 亚洲英雄-没有硝烟的战争
programme.desc: 自古乱世出英雄,在2003年春天的一场没有硝烟的战争中,一群舍己救人的真英雄诞生了。在一轮出生入死的拼搏过后,写下了香港杏林史上引以为傲的一页,亦叫早己冷却的心再一次跳动。

programme.title: 赞美之泉
programme.desc: 一首既悦耳又有意思的诗歌,可以洗涤心灵,感化人心,创世电视带你走进福音歌曲新领域。

programme.title: 灵修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 「创世电视福音主日」-不由你不信之从灵界迷惑到真相大白
programme.desc: 「超阔银幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大众化的福音主题」,加上「诚意的款待」会产生极致的「福音体验」。奉主的名 带著权柄与邪灵争战。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天5 我为上帝精彩过
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠

programme.title: 葛培理牧师特辑
programme.desc: 节目记录葛培理布道团最新福音事工,并葛培理牧师70年来布道的足迹及对世界各地的贡献,让我们面对不同的世情,仍然把握机会传福音。

programme.title: 圣地流动教室-以色列破谜之旅
programme.desc: 通晓中西方历史、文学、艺术、民间传说的学者吴宗文牧师,以及主持梁艺龄,透过镜头带著电视观众,去到圣地各站游历,呈现出新旧约的《圣经》典故、历史文献的记载、相关的犹太传说和传统习俗,而更重要是从耶稣和初期信徒的记载,带出人生的重要特质,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 航向未来粤

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 糖尿病病人都可能有低血糖症？内分泌及糖尿科医生拆解个中原因。另外，低血糖症也有假？医生指要「笃手指」分辨真假，再寻找适当食物让血糖升回正常水平。医生更警告不要擅自停药，或会有甚么并发症？久坐与不良姿势或会引致「死臀综合症」，意指臀肌逐渐遗忘了如何收缩与发力。病症初期会以临床诊断为先，治疗主方向则以运动激活已休眠的肌肉，物理治疗师会亲自示范相关动作。「睇𩠌食饭」，傅季馨炮制「大闸蟹粉拌意大利面」。

programme.title: 甜心教室粤
programme.desc: 父亲节快到，阮政峰与李豪为答谢古嘉俊(古Sir)教导，扬言送上名贵礼物给他惊喜，古Sir有何反应？古Sir建议做「牛奶朱古力红酒苹果蛋糕」，两位「同学仔」学做「红酒苹果馅料」时，古Sir为何忍不住抛出「金句」，一再强调红酒「好贵」？古Sir示范「牛奶朱古力慕丝」，讲解令忌廉更滑的窍门。他有感而发指出「同学仔」专心做「靓」甜品，才是最佳谢师礼物！这款蛋糕富艺术感，亦是父亲节精选的甜品，大家不妨参考！

programme.title: 大帅哥#6粤PG
programme.desc: 狄奇准备向落芦用刑，落芦看穿他虚张声势，劝他赶快逃离升威镇，狄奇诉说四兄弟感情深厚，不会撇下他们，落芦嗤之以鼻。狄奇猜出落芦与冬来关系不寻常，向落芦展示一把扇后放了他，还将少帅交给他，只要求他不向升威镇发砲，自己会单人匹马上山迎砲弹。狄奇用计绑起众兄弟，独自上山。落芦提议由先根亲自开砲杀狄奇，怎料冬来突然扑出，令狄奇的计划出现变数，马炭亦为救沅婉导致断指。狄奇回归升威镇，惊闻天娇被卖往日式妓院……

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 三位同学仔跟儿童体适能教练「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，有助强化心肺功能，过程中难免会喘气。「蹲」是这节心肺功能训练的重点，腿部会有酸软感。双手提起至额头前，做出类近拳手挥拳及避开对手的动作，心跳频率有所增加就代表到位。锻练过后，教练带来有关下肢的伸展运动，让肌肉有所舒缓。躺在瑜伽垫上，保持畅顺呼吸，尝试用双手把大腿拉近胸口。时常久坐的小朋友，不时要伸展一下，减少因姿势不正确引起的痛症问题。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 看过阳葵与美月的演唱会，令偶像公主模特儿珠莉亚大为心动，决定加入偶像公主学会。可是，珠莉亚认为自己一日无法完美歌唱，一日都无法上台做演唱会。为了更了解珠莉亚，阳葵与美月决定向她请教拍照的秘诀。

programme.desc: 遨游全世界最受欢迎且充满美态与魅力的旅游胜地，欣赏美妙的天然奇景、引人入胜的古迹、精湛的手工艺和迷人的景色。带观众踏上难忘的旅程，融入梦想旅游目的地的传统与历史里。

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 阿曼弯刀, 一种阿曼传统表演-阿尔拉兹法的重要配饰 弯刀是阿曼珍贵的文化遗产, 象征住阿曼的历史和身份, 甚至于国家徽章都能看到其踪影 本集将介绍阿曼弯刀的制作过程及传统意义

programme.title: 文明启航粤英
programme.desc: 历史学家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人类历史上最引人入胜的故事，揭开世界各地鲜为人知的历史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 如果这样生活粤 及 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
programme.desc: 「型格大叔」袁文杰遇上日本「逆流大叔」，一起给单亲小孩送上「父爱」。文杰跟他切磋柔术，又献出爱心，加入小朋友战团同玩乐。文杰还当上「出租大叔」，夹公仔、影贴纸相氹得掂学生妹，但一到唱K，鸿沟出现！面对尴尬的年龄隔阂，「挨」到出粮一刻，终于松一口气。还是贴地做个日本大叔，学跳舞却跟不上节奏，转场到机铺打机，瞬间被挑机者KO。夜里，文杰的盘川所剩无几，唯有到街边档食碗面，感叹人到中年的无奈！

programme.title: 兄弟姊妹去旅行粤
programme.desc: 来到琉森湖旁的小镇布龙嫩，子羚、定欣忽发奇想，要两男跟瑞士人学唱歌，自己学吹阿尔卑斯长号及挥旗，还组成合唱团在湖边开骚。两位前歌手走音不断，阿廉竟然「赖」瑞士空气太好？两男到军刀专门店自制万用军刀，最终刻上谁的名字？四人坐船游琉森湖，欣赏周边景色及日落，顺道交心，抛出一堆假设性问题，哪位看似较开放或花弗？走入一间花园式布置的餐厅，享用「厨师发办」餐，分享旅行的「怪异」经历，阿廉有个真人真事要分享！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 周星驰在香港影视圈地位超然，更被封为「无厘头」喜剧始祖。为拆解星爷的传奇成就，谷主们率先回顾他的成长轨迹。原来星爷的演艺之路并非一帆风顺，不但曾投考TVB艺训班遭遇挫折，更熬过长达六年的跑龙套岁月。自主演经典剧集《盖世豪侠》走红后，星爷随即全面进军大银幕，缔造无数经典；及后他逐步退居幕后担任导演及编剧，作品亦屡创票房纪录。然而，这幕后身分的蜕变却惹来影迷两极评价，众谷主对此又有甚么看法？

programme.title: 汇丰卓越理财呈献:卓越汇谈粤
programme.desc: 累积财富后如何令家庭及子女的未来更有保障？汇丰卓越理财《卓越汇谈》聚焦四大主题，涵盖财富管理、环球升学、家庭健康、旅游及时尚品味礼遇，结合专业观点，提供实用资讯让观众更全面规划未来。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 IV粤
programme.desc: 《警声百二秒 IV》引领观众「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭过去未来」，并继续以轻松有趣的系列表达方式，让市民接收丰富的警队资讯，说好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 第73届澳门格兰披治大赛车直播粤英
programme.desc: 国际车坛盛会「澳门格兰披治大赛车」，2026年11月中旬踏入第73届赛事，来自多个国家及地区的顶尖赛车手，将会在东望洋赛道飞驰，力争成为各项比赛的最终王者！TVB于11月21日(星期六)、22日(星期日)一连两天，送上连场精彩刺激的极速较量！

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 这次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」针对核心肌肉，对增强胃口或有少许帮助呢！地上放好瑜伽垫，先做热身运动。完成「平板支撑」、「空中脚踏车」、「俄罗斯转体」、「卷腹」、「侧平板支撑」共五个动作之后，腹部力量似有所提升。第二节，健身教练指引大家做「全身协调训练」，原地踏步时，手轻拍腹部，会有健脾开胃功效？然后拿起水樽做抛接动作，眼力和身体协调度缺一不可。另外，「动物好萌友」环节介绍睫角守宫。

programme.title: 动物超能力粤英
programme.desc: 动物王国里充满了拥有超能力的不可思议生物！节目每一集会以不同的主题呈现，以及由不同领域的专家带来令人震惊的知识作讲解。

programme.title: 安妮的童话粤日
programme.desc: 安妮得知戴安娜擅自替她投稿并加入泡打粉广告，令小说得奖，心情复杂。回到大学后，她收养流浪猫屈士丁，并与室友展开热闹同居生活。基尔伯特向安妮求婚被拒，安妮事后动摇，回到艾凡里重新整理心情。

programme.title: 潮流生活志之时尚头条粤
programme.desc: 香港，一个中西荟萃、新旧共融的国际都市，不论吃喝、玩乐、购物都多姿多采。节目中主持人会介绍最新的潮流资讯和生活热话，为你发掘香港更精彩的一面，讲究生活和追求时尚的你绝对不能错过。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 本港近年发生多宗独居及隐蔽长者在家离世的悲剧，有关注团体指出，不少长者不懂得、或者不愿向外界求助，长期处于支援网络之外。政府近年推出「支援长者及照顾者计划」，动员各区关爱队上门「洗楼」，协助识别独居、双老及隐蔽长者，不过单靠拍门家访，未必能成功接触这批最需要帮助的群体，究竟要如何打破隔膜，真正了解隐蔽长者的需求？要扩展社区支援网络，协助他们重返社区，政府、社福界以至邻里之间，又可以如何走多一步？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 恒生银行呈献：「恒」动全城 — 全民皆「乒」粤
programme.desc: 为硬撼港队退役名将，展鹏特邀港队前总教练陈江华训练明星乒乓球队，焯日、晋乐、映彤被点名可稍被期待。首战面对9岁以下的育苗精英队，明星队赛前笑言不想「大虾细」，怎料出现1：11赛果？随后跟全运会元老队作单、双打，明星队要使出换人战术应对。与银行精英队上演别开生面的乒乓小游戏，双方竟然势均力敌？终极一战，名将队于让分下与明星队对决，更有专业评术钟志光监场。映彤表现毫不怯场，面对强劲对手也敢放胆抽击！

programme.title: 香港旅游发展局呈献：香港连场好戏粤
programme.desc: 不少亚洲影视作品都在香港留下鲜明足迹，戏迷煲剧兼朝圣取景地。走过怡和街行人天桥，相聚于怀旧茶餐厅，从《难哄》角度记录港式情怀。旧湾仔码头纵完成历史任务，但《水饺皇后》的励志故事已刻下光影印记。坐摩天轮俯瞰维港夜景，回味《樱桃琥珀》的心动画面。跟随《你好，爱，再见》步调，一探兰桂坊的璀璨夜色与长洲的渔村风情。大街小巷都可找到文化气息，漫步西营盘壁画街、中西区半山、西九海滨，投入《瑞草洞》的浪漫氛围。

programme.title: 丰隆旅游保险呈献：跟风旅行团粤
programme.desc: 某影片创作者花半日，在圣水洞的时尚地标商场里尽情购物，此举交由杜如风「演绎」，相信是另一层次！影片攻略是先到五楼Cafe取筹，但一楼的不定期专题展览几乎令如风忘了这事。取筹后，逛逛太阳眼镜店与潮帽店，正当如风拣好「心头帽」时，幕后团队竟要全体坐车离开放饭？Cafe主打新潮艺术甜品，如风的最终食评是「艺术成分甚高」。也可随如风一探其私心推介的爆汁烤肠餐厅，尝味非一般牛杂，但令她「安歌」的竟是生牛肝！

programme.title: TVB迈向60年节目巡礼2027粤PG
programme.desc: TVB继续炮制连场好戏！《驱魔速递》融合武打玄幻；相隔多年，《超时空男臣》载誉归来揭新篇；林盛斌伙拍罗子溢爆笑合演《警是个大佬》。更有「影后」袁咏仪压阵主演《模仿人生》，以及罗嘉良回归力作《模范律师团》。综艺阵容同样令人期待！罗子溢与洪永城出游《大丈夫步步为营》；金牌媒人林盛斌主理熟龄恋综《钻石恋爱计划》；马国明、萧正楠和曹永廉找艺人老友，密谋《三生有幸去黐餐》。艺训班训练，还会搬上真人骚舞台？

programme.title: 邵逸夫奖2026颁奖典礼粤
programme.desc: 2026年度邵逸夫生命科学与医学奖，平均颁予安妮‧德尚、戴宇阁及陈竺，以表彰他们发现急性早幼粒细胞白血病在分子与细胞层面的致病基础，并开创了协同标靶治疗方案，令这种疾病从最致命的癌症行列，转变为治愈率最高的癌症之一，治愈率超过九成。2026年度邵逸夫数学科学奖由伊曼纽尔‧康德斯和卡米洛‧德‧雷列斯获得，以表彰他们在运用深刻数学分析技术，解决重要应用方面取得的突破性贡献。而天文学奖则平均颁予野本宪一，以及斯坦福‧伍斯利，以表彰他们对恒星爆炸和元素起源的研究。

programme.title: 香港赛马会特约：J Sport粤
programme.desc: 十八岁新星马嘉言勇夺保龄球世界杯金牌，事隔十一年再有港将登顶，他会分享喜悦。先进保龄球亚锦赛亦传捷报，两本港球手共摘一金一铜。女车手杨嘉怡于亚太区赛车锦标赛获得铜牌，在男士主导的赛场绽放光芒。香港公开羽毛球锦标赛火热举行，港队表现如何？维港泳也受关注，港将冼展霆、聂芷彦蝉联竞赛组男、女子冠军。三人篮球赛即将上演，香港队名将查华斯讲述打波技巧。另搜罗港珠澳大桥半马拉松战报，及棍网球六人赛记招花絮。

programme.title: 我的志愿粤
programme.desc: 冲动鲁莽、不可一世，曾是崔建邦(Amigo)予人的负面形象！这位「金牌司仪」曾因卷入伤人与醉驾案件，事业随之直插谷底。陷入低潮的Amigo恍如擂台上中拳倒地的拳手，他其后如何汲取教训重新振作，凭著坚强意志在人生赛场上反败为胜？2017年1月，Amigo以年近40之龄参与一场拳击赛事，透过实践儿时志愿展示「重生」志向。节目纪录其赛前290天艰苦特训过程，曾志伟、郑秀文等星级好友，细说他的改变历程。

programme.title: 夫妇的世界
programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 热血军检(完)
programme.desc: 【安普贤携手曹宝儿，成最强军检察官搭档！！】以韩国军事法庭为背景，为了各自目的而成为军检察官，都培万只想往上爬达成复仇目标，车友仁出身军法世家，为替父母讨回公道而回到军中。当军中黑暗势力浮上台面，他们选择不再服从命令，而是直面权力、揭露真相。在正义与复仇之间，两人逐步找回真正的信念，也点燃危险又炙热的同盟关系，从对立到并肩作战的故事。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微风
programme.desc: 【千亿遗产考验林智妍沦落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一场跨越南北的失散命运，意外揭开千亿财产背后的血缘骗局。脱北女孩微风重返南韩，与多年不见的初恋律师长高重逢，却被卷入豪门争产与身世之谜。冒名孙女设局夺产，谎言层层堆叠，亲情逐渐崩裂；长高的母亲强势介入，以门第与前途逼迫儿子放弃真爱。当真相一一曝光，有人为贪念付出惨痛代价，有人失去一切。被牺牲的爱情，是否还能在命运翻转后，迎来真正的团圆？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破脸！命运抓弄下的同居奇迹】一场毁灭性的家庭变故，让原本关系紧绷的离婚婆婆、媳妇与小姑，命运交织地被迫同住在一个屋簷下。撕下以往的对立标签，三个性格迥异、伤痕累累的女人在满是摩擦与冲突的日常中，渐渐看清彼此的脆弱。她们相互扶持、携手抵御人生的逆境风浪，最终走出阴霾，共筑出比血缘更坚固的暖心情谊！

programme.desc: 【闺蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宫血洗渣男小三】医院副院长池善雨拥有令人羡慕的完美生活，却因一根神秘发丝，惊觉导演丈夫早已出轨富家千金，且身边挚友全都是帮忙隐瞒的帮凶。面对爱情与友情的双重背叛，彻底心碎的她不再隐忍，决心化身复仇女神。她智商在线地精心设局，利用财产、孩子与社会地位作为筹码，与丈夫展开一场玉石俱焚的心理战与利益争夺，将虚伪的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 逆转女王
programme.desc: 【经典韩剧《贤内助女王》姊妹作】黄泰熙原是高薪的开发组长，但为了追求幸福家庭，她选择与新同事奉俊秀结婚。然而她的决定，却让她被信任的女上司赶出公司，只能在家当贤内助。五年后，泰熙感到现实生活的沉重，决定重返职场。在公司她遇见了具勇植，一位支持她的本部长。泰熙在勇植的鼓励下展现出更坚韧的一面，最终成功东山再起，找到了新的事业目标。

programme.title: 等待京道
programme.desc: 【朴叙俊回归携手《鱿鱼2》元志安《等待京道》谱十年宿命恋】十年后的重逢，让李京道与徐智友再度陷入爱情的漩涡。曾是彼此初恋的两人，如今一个是追寻真相的记者，一个是丑闻风暴中的名门继承人。再见面时，他们早已不是年少时的模样，却依然在对方身上看见过去的自己。爱情与现实的距离，在一次次试探与退让间拉扯，他们明知前方满是荆棘，仍选择再次并肩。

programme.title: 我亲爱的朋友们
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十岁的我们 终于学会说不】她们是一群走过风雨的老人，曾为家庭默默奉献，如今选择为自己绽放。一场聚会重新牵起年少情谊，也掀开多年压抑的心事。有人鼓起勇气离婚，搬进梦想中的小屋；有人在意外后学会面对过错，重拾友情的信任；有人对抗失智，却仍记得朋友的名字与笑声。女儿朴莞在倾听中理解母亲，在书写中记录她们的光芒。人生未晚，她们手牵著手，用皱纹写下温柔，也用笑声走向崭新的旅程。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.desc: 【朴叙俊回归携手《鱿鱼2》元志安《等待京道》谱十年宿命恋】十年后的重逢，让李京道与徐智友再度陷入爱情的漩涡。曾是彼此初恋的两人，如今一个是追寻真相的记者，一个是丑闻风暴中的名门继承人。再见面时，他们早已不是年少时的模样，却依然在对方身上看见过去的自己。爱情与现实的距离，在一次次试探与退让间拉扯，他们明知前方满是荆棘，仍选择再次并肩。

programme.title: 我亲爱的朋友们
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十岁的我们 终于学会说不】她们是一群走过风雨的老人，曾为家庭默默奉献，如今选择为自己绽放。一场聚会重新牵起年少情谊，也掀开多年压抑的心事。有人鼓起勇气离婚，搬进梦想中的小屋；有人在意外后学会面对过错，重拾友情的信任；有人对抗失智，却仍记得朋友的名字与笑声。女儿朴莞在倾听中理解母亲，在书写中记录她们的光芒。人生未晚，她们手牵著手，用皱纹写下温柔，也用笑声走向崭新的旅程。

programme.title: 逆转女王
programme.desc: 【经典韩剧《贤内助女王》姊妹作】黄泰熙原是高薪的开发组长，但为了追求幸福家庭，她选择与新同事奉俊秀结婚。然而她的决定，却让她被信任的女上司赶出公司，只能在家当贤内助。五年后，泰熙感到现实生活的沉重，决定重返职场。在公司她遇见了具勇植，一位支持她的本部长。泰熙在勇植的鼓励下展现出更坚韧的一面，最终成功东山再起，找到了新的事业目标。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女医明妃传
programme.desc: 【刘诗诗淡妆出镜美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女国医！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得从医也难治隐疾。杭允贤从小耳濡目染，偷偷随祖母学习中医知识，不仅在学医道路上面临重重的困难和阻碍，更要面对封建礼教和世俗观念的冲击。开创并建立女医制度，从救人身体到救人灵魂，悬壶济世、妙手仁心的名声，得到普通百姓的赞扬和支持。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 完全省钱恋爱手册
programme.desc: 【精打细算的恋爱，郭书瑶vs林子闳金钱价值观保卫战，有钱没钱都要爱！！】不追求恋爱的节俭会计师上班族简可可，平易近人做事俐落、个性率直又善良。碰上了花钱如流水的同事王海阔，是能力强、业界有名的王牌业务。对彼此逐渐动心的爱情，两人的金钱价值观却大大不同，要如何在爱情与面包做选择呢?

programme.title: 九尾狐传
programme.desc: 【人间九尾狐李栋旭苦等初恋大谈人狐千年禁忌恋！！】活在现代的九尾狐李砚，身兼著阎罗王姐姐的阴间使者指令，斩妖除魔苦苦等候初恋南智雅转世千年在今生相遇，做为半人半妖的同父异母弟弟李朗，频频与李砚作对搅局。过去亲情、爱情、友情的磨难及错误的种子，在此世会得到解答吗?

programme.title: 我把社长解锁了
programme.desc: 【人气网漫改编，影帝朴星雄解密手机AI的技术奇幻职场剧！】国内市占率最高的科技公司创办人天才CEO金成柱，因突发事件被杀手追杀成了谋杀案受害者，灵魂尚未离开人世而换个方式存活在刚大学毕业出社会朴仁成的手机内。为找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO开始两人的合作。

programme.desc: What if one meal could change history? After talented chef Manceron is unceremoniously fired by his noble master, an unexpected partnership with a spirited stranger sparks romance, revenge and the creation of France's very first restaurant.

programme.desc: Amir loves Narges and Narges loves Amir. But their hopes and dreams for a life together collide head on with the web of tradition, corruption, and social hierarchy that continues to rule over the lives of a new generation in Iran.

programme.title: Lemonade
programme.desc: Mara, a young Romanian mother, is a caretaker in the US on a temporary visa. Life seemed perfect after she got married and brought her son over. However, she faces abuses of power from the officer in her green card process, who seeks to exploit her plight.

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Cement

programme.title: For Night Will Come

programme.title: Running On Sand
programme.desc: When an Eritrean refugee about to be deported from Israel is mistaken for the Nigerian striker just signed to a struggling soccer team, his fate depends on the team’s success in this charming, socially relevant dramedy.

programme.title: In Other Circumstances: Death of a Stalker

programme.title: Elaha
programme.desc: Elaha, a young Kurdish-German woman, battles patriarchy and family expectations while seeking her own path. Elaha struggles with traditions, marriage and virginity, and she must choose between emancipation or delusion.

programme.title: Lightning-Struck

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Prehistoric Picnic
programme.desc: Andy meets some peckish Pachycephalosaurus, a hungry T-rex and a pterosaur.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Bella and Lift make a new friend with an awesome roar, Steggy the Dinosaur! Together, they visit Tincy in the Sing Song Forest for a dinosaur song.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Space Badge
programme.desc: Duggee teaches the squirrels all about the stars, the planets and the Milky Way!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Everglades National Park, Florida
programme.desc: The Go Jetters save the Florida Everglades when hungry alligators chase Glitch's picnic.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Timgad Ruins, Algeria
programme.desc: The Go Jetters visit Timgad in Algeria, but someone is playing games with their click-ons.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Thomas' Not So Lucky Day
programme.desc: It's Friday the 13th in Italy and Thomas tries to improve his luck by following Lorenzo and Beppe's advice on superstitions.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Never-Done-It Day﻿
programme.desc: When Nana reveals she's never had a dosa, the family all try something new and have a Never-Done-It day! Will Nikhil and Jay be able to find something Jim has never done before?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - House
programme.desc: Myrtle's aunt Cressy is coming to stay, and she needs Stanley to make her a bed for her. This escalates into Stanley building her a whole set of rooms outside Myrtles actual house.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Museum
programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise there's nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Always Wanted to be a Crab
programme.desc: The talking animals talk about all the things they love about the ocean.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time for night time workers
programme.desc: When Neil the postie delivers Gran Gran's mail early in the morning, JoJo is amazed to discover that some grown-ups go to work when she's asleep. JoJo and Gran Gran spend the day learning all about night-time workers.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Traffic Badge
programme.desc: It's a hot day so Duggee is treating the Squirrels to a trip to the tropical lake. It's particularly busy out today and there's a traffic jam! Thank goodness Duggee has his traffic badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Water Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels learn all about where water comes from, and their journey takes them from the sea and back to the kitchen sink and another drink of water. Wow! Water is amazing!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Cheeky Chicks
programme.desc: Maisy finds cheeky chicks hiding around the farm and brings them back to the hen house.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Butterflies
programme.desc: Maisy and Cyril discover a butterfly at home, and transform into butterflies themselves!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Kiwi
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Kiwi performing Do the Kiwi Dance - if he manages to find someone to interview him first.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Coconut
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Coconut getting his moment in the limelight with his sea shanty Oh, the Big Waves - if he manages to overcome a little stage fright.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Operation Kiwi
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Museum Mischief
programme.desc: Evil Pea pretends to help Supertato and Carrot train for crime prevention, but she tricks them and steals a mobile phone. Supertato and Carrot have a clever plan to get it back.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Tiddly Phone
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa­Laa and Po receive a call on the Tubby Phone. It's the Tiddlytubbies who ring to say hello, just before the Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S04 - Cheese
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'cheese' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Cavity Cave
programme.desc: Messy brushes his teeth, but why must we use toothpaste and a toothbrush to get teeth clean? He goes to OKIDO to find out.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ludwig The Lady
programme.desc: Jackson's big, blue chicken-thing, Ludwig, is going to lay an egg. And it's up to Mojo and Bo to carry the big bird across dangerous roads to Preston's egg-hatching shed!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.desc: Glitch takes all of the colourful powder from the Festival of Colour in Dwarka, India. Can the Go Jetters get it back?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death-a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: Love on Delivery

Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Viral Factor

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man’s matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Yat Mei and his disciples live in a remote village until Sister Maria restores an abandoned church, awakening a long-dormant vampire missionary. As panic spreads and Taoist exorcism fails, Yat Mei joins forces with a Western priest, combining Eastern and Western powers to battle evil.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Mother VS Mother

programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship

However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 青春进化论第107集
programme.desc: 在全球一片鼓励创新创业的风潮下，台湾未来的发展要有竞争力，即需要不断的创新，让年轻人有更多机会实现想法及创意，不仅是在协助青年圆梦，更是在打造国家的未来。节目中创业者分享创业甘苦谈，创业时面临的心理挣扎，以及如何克服困难，坚持理想，继续走下去。【青年创ya家】主持人曾宝仪打破传统一问一答的制式访问，以如同家人、朋友间的聊天谈心，让各种你想得到的、想不到的青年创ya家，抛开紧张与包袱，轻松自在地分享自己的「青春进化论」。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1880集
programme.desc: 人间卫视【生活智多星】邀请到「好门媳妇」－郁方担任主持人，透过轻松活泼的访谈，让您成为生活上「智多星」。本节目邀请不同领域的专家学者，从科学的观点，深入浅出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑虑与似是而非的伪知识，了解事情的源由与真相，提供不一样的想法与见解。【生活智多星】内容丰富多元，例如针对银发族的需求，邀请银发族运动专家，将因久坐而气滞血瘀的沙发马铃薯大变身，强力打造出活力四射、充满元气的不老传说。以及有关吃的大哉问：吃进嘴里的是营养还是毒药，吃的顺序、吃的方法与吃的健康，从不吃坏肚子到吃到强身健体，【生活智多星】全面关心。

programme.title: 布袋小和尚第13集
programme.desc: 说趣事․悟禅理․善能量以生动易懂的品德道理为主旨，精采呈现一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禅理动画作品。《布袋小和尚》是中国大陆首部为孩子原创制作的禅意动画片。《布袋小和尚》以弥勒佛化身的布袋和尚为原型，以奉化雪窦寺为故事发生地，讲述一个逍遥自在、无拘无束、笑口常开的大肚弥勒小和尚，和他的伙伴小布袋、吉祥鸟，被委以修建庙宇的重任。在重建庙宇的过程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各种稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚运用他的聪明才智和神奇布袋，扬善惩恶，帮助百姓克服困难，用爱心温暖人间。剧情轻松有趣又感人，将中华传统美德融入其中，使得教育与娱乐相结合，教导少年儿童做好事、说好话、存好心等行为道德，在笑中体会道德的光芒

programme.title: 幸福的起点第19集
programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第40集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大马慈济情第668集

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第61集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: TRY科学第37集
programme.desc: 你我的生活小问号，可能成就科学大发现。所以号召全民try科学，活化每个人潜在的科学基因。 生鸡蛋握掌心，为什么连壮汉都捏不破？！ 一片口香糖，要怎么打开没拉环的易开罐？ 科学基因不限男女老幼贫富贵贱，科学现象不分校园、街头、办公室或客厅，Try科学想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心。 Try科学以放大生活中各种有趣现象为诱因，以主持人科学机智问答的闯关设计，透过科学MAN吸引眼球的科学实验与找答案的逻辑推理……让科学接地气，让科学活用在生活里。

programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 静思妙莲华第253集
programme.desc: 每天清晨静思精舍早课后， 证严上人亲选重要佛经讲解，辅以社会现况、人间故事做开示，将两千五百年前的 佛陀说法，与二十一世纪世间法相呼应。

programme.title: 静思妙莲华第254集
programme.desc: 每天清晨静思精舍早课后， 证严上人亲选重要佛经讲解，辅以社会现况、人间故事做开示，将两千五百年前的 佛陀说法，与二十一世纪世间法相呼应。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第60集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大爱学汉医第740集
programme.desc: 让世界看懂中医，打破中医的框架迷思，发挥预防重于治疗的优点，让台湾走向乐活社会。

programme.title: 人间菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分钟， 证严上人以佛心应世事，结合台湾社会脉动、全球趋势，从后山看世界。

programme.title: 幸福的起点第20集
programme.desc: 林雅美从小活泼聪明，林父身体不好，雅美从十岁开始学做生意，很快地展现她做生意的天赋，雅美是米行的超级业务员，同时也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什么事情，天塌下来，总有大姊撑著。 雅美能干又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是适婚年纪，不过碾米厂家业全仰赖雅美，雅美根本无意出嫁。林父林母紧张，就像米一样，老米在市场上是没有竞争力的。父母积极地为雅美安排相亲，雅美体贴父母的心意，答应了相亲。不过雅美有个但书，她无论如何不要嫁给做生意的人，她已经厌倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要进入婚姻，她只想要找一个老老实实的上班族。

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6929集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 人文讲堂第475集
programme.desc: 《人文讲堂》节目，邀请台湾各行各业杰出人士、学者专家，或热爱生命者，将多年的学识涵养、人文感受，以及对生命的活力，以讲演方式，直接与大众分享。讲演的内容及方式，不再流于传统，不仅是知识或专业技术而已，更会呈现出特有的人文观点。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第6集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.title: 行动现场第545集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第285集

programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 映照人生第528集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 守护大自然第3集
programme.desc: 印尼原住民族世代与自然共存，以传统智慧守护森林、海洋与土地。面对开发变迁，仍坚守文化及生态平衡，为后代留下珍贵传承。

programme.title: 大爱全纪实第199集
programme.desc: 慈济四大八法推广与传播,关注地球与人类永续发展议题。 解读近代事件中，慈济「曾经」参与的足迹，至今「正在」持续的行动，以及留给「未来」的影响力。 为观众传播慈济四大八法，剖析探讨慈济人如何关注地球永续发展、推动拔苦予乐的希望工程。

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第286集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 情比姊妹深第8集
programme.desc: 黎兰章出生于南部农家，从小跟著父亲做农，结婚后家庭幸福美满，孰料先生早逝，她独力抚养两个孩子，这段期间兰章受到朋友同事的关心与照顾，才能度过人生的低潮，为了回馈社会的爱心，兰章加入了慈济。因受到上人的感召，兰章自认文的不会，武的也不会，只会做环保。兰章十几年不感动许多志工纷纷加入，但困难的是始终没有固定的环保点，她的坚持与不退，感动了丽梅师姊，提供固定的场地给兰章做环保，也终于不用再流浪。她们用做环保来实践上人的法，也吸引了很多志工加入，兰章跟丽梅认为环保道场就是人间净土，也是她们及志工们的心灵修道场。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第61集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第211集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 行动现场第546集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第630集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第748集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 《新霹雳英雄榜》是一部动作冒险类型的电视剧或电影系列，为霹雳布袋戏的新一代作品。故事背景设定在一个神秘的武林世界，充满了武术、魔法和神秘力量。故事围绕著一群英雄人物展开，他们各自拥有独特的技能和身世背景。他们将面临来自黑暗势力和邪恶组织的威胁，必须团结一致，通过战斗和冒险来守护正义和保护世界的平衡。《新霹雳英雄榜》融合了激烈的打斗场面、刺激的动作场景和细腻的角色发展，带给观众一场震撼的视觉盛宴。剧情扣人心弦，充满著惊险、奇幻和神秘的元素，同时也融入了人物之间的情感和义务的探讨。这部作品以霹雳布袋戏的独特风格和特色为基础，结合了现代特效和技术，将传统和现代元素相结合，呈现出一个全新的霹雳世界。观

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第10集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨龄差距的结伴青春旅行，走访在地文化行销台湾，世代差异的旅游个性激荡出充满意外性的实境自助旅行。当稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，会擦出什么火花呢?这是一段花甲老熟肉与少年小鲜肉们，跨越大龄差距，结伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鲜肉们想什么？而老熟肉们又会怎么玩？透过世代差异，激荡出观众意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅游实境节目，纪录跨世代的艺人们难忘的友情之旅！从陌生到熟悉！ 从畏惧到麻吉！让小鲜肉成长！让老熟肉回春！不啰唆！现在出发吧～

programme.title: 包青天第135集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「狸猫换太子」等。

programme.title: 肌肉魔法使第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 这里是魔法的世界，众人将使用魔法这件事视为理所当然，并且使用魔法技术优劣决定地位高低。在深山的森林中，有一位不断进行肌肉训练的少年。这位少年名叫「马修．班地德」，——『他不会魔法』。马修是个异类，因为他天生就不会使用魔法，被养父藏匿起来照顾。养父生怕他因此被别人伤害，便从小教他重训，希望他可以用体魄来保护自己……意想不到的是在不断的锻炼之下，马修的肌肉不只能保护自己，更足以粉碎绝大多数的魔法！？为了让自己跟家人能够平安生活，决定用长年锻炼出来的一身肌肉与世界抗衡。不正常的奇幻故事，就此开始！
